snippet.title: Electrogical | Steam Early Access Launch Trailer - November 2024
snippet.description:
Electrogical is a math-bending jigsaw puzzle game where numbers power the grid! Winner of the 1st GYAAR Studio Indie Game Contest, Electrogical blends arithmetic and strategy for endless fun— perfect for puzzle lovers, math enthusiasts, or anyone looking for a fresh challenge!

----------------------------------------
⚡️ Available now on Steam Early Access ⚡️
Get it now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2501650/Electrogical/
----------------------------------------


🔗 Official Links:
